Delhi Police Protest: Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) Manasvi Vashishtha was suspended after staging a protest outside the Police Headquarters on Monday. ACP Vashishtha joined police personnel in a protest outside the force’s headquarters on Monday against the transfer of two officers — one of whom was Vashistha himself —after a scuffle with lawyers at Shahdara police station on October 23.
